question: Does any third-party aggregator currently (2025-2026) sync Fidelity Charitable Giving Accounts through Fidelity's Akoya/Fidelity Access API? Check public institution lists and help-centre known-issue pages of Morningstar ByAllAccounts, Empower, Quicken/Simplifi, Plaid, Yodlee/Envestnet, eMoney and Addepar for 'Fidelity Charitable' entries and their status
conclusion_affected: A1/A3 Y data-portability score for Fidelity; whether the License Agreement s.8 third-party channel is live
rationale: Morningstar's July 2023 notices list 'Fidelity Charitable Gift Fund (Investment)' (FI 44892) among accounts moving to Akoya, primary holder only. An Empower help article (search index, undated) says these accounts can no longer sync under the Fidelity Investments option. Fidelity's own help pages document PDF download only

question: Which DAF-adjacent vendors hold a California charitable fundraising platform (PL-1) registration, and with which solicitation types (A-E)? Candidates: Chariot (DAFpay), Daffy, Every.org, Endaoment, Givinga, Ren (DonorFirst/iPhi white-label portals), Benevity, PayPal Giving Fund. Use public registry data or a human browser session (no account login), and record whether any white-label DAF portal vendor registered under Type E
conclusion_affected: Entrant simulation 'state registration' row; whether a white-label DAF portal licensed to a sponsor is a Type E platform in practice
rationale: On the statute's text a SaaS platform that lets a charity (including a DAF sponsor) 'solicit or receive donations' is Type E, and the sponsor's DAF exclusion does not extend to its vendor. The vendor exclusion covers only vendors serving a charitable fundraising platform. Registry practice is the only evidence of how the AG reads this. The registry search is a web form, which this mission's rules exclude

question: Does the current (2026) Candid Charity Check PDF v2 output print the time as well as the date of generation, and an express statement that BMF data are from the most current EO BMF Extract, as Rev. Proc. 2018-32 s.8.01(1)(b)-(c) requires? Look for 2026-dated Charity Check PDFs attached to public grant files, board packets or audit workpapers, and for any Candid update replacing the citation to superseded Rev. Proc. 2011-33
conclusion_affected: A5 Candid compliance-evidence quality; whether sponsors need the JSON report_date (GMT time) in addition to the PDF
rationale: Candid's public sample PDF (generated 2025-04-16) shows name, EIN, foundation status, deductibility and 'Most recent IRS BMF' date, but only a date for generation and no 'most current update' statement. It cites Rev. Proc. 2011-33. The JSON API's report_date carries date and time in GMT
